packageRules.description: Auto-merge minor and patch updates once the Test checks pass. Major updates wait for review.
Group dev dependency minor/patch updates into one PR.
Dev dependency and GitHub Actions updates must not publish a new npm version (see .releaserc).
@types/node must match the minimum supported Node version (engines in package.json), so never propose major bumps.
Lockfile-only updates (the version stays within the range in package.json) change nothing users install, so they must not publish a new npm version (see .releaserc).
